cls.name: Entity
cls.description: Anything the supply-chain ontology can talk about.

children.name: Asset
children.description: A physical production asset with a health state.

children.name: CatalogObject
children.description: An SAP Business Data Cloud catalog artefact. Kept as a separate branch: it describes what data exists, not what the supply chain is.

children.name: Facility
children.description: A physical site with capacity. Abstract: the network has only plants today, but distribution centres and contract manufacturers are the same kind of thing.

children.name: MaterialCategory
children.description: A class of material the network moves. Sole-source risk is a property of a category, not of a plant, which is why it needs to be its own class.

children.name: MaterialFlow
children.description: A recurring movement of one material category between two entities, carrying monthly volume and value. Reified as a class because the flow itself has attributes the endpoints do not.

children.name: Party
children.description: An external organisation the network trades with. Abstract, so a question about 'who is affected' can span suppliers and customers in one answer.

children.name: Transaction
children.description: A business document that commits the supply chain to deliver.

relations_out.name: flowsTo
relations_out.description: Material moves from one entity to another. Abstract parent of the three concrete flow types, so a traversal can follow any of them.

relations_in.name: flowsTo
relations_in.description: Material moves from one entity to another. Abstract parent of the three concrete flow types, so a traversal can follow any of them.
